subject: M031 simulation-world boundaries, semantic contracts, persistence/inspection evidence, and bounded headless wood workflow
acceptanceCriteria: The implementation preserves one authoritative world, explicit region partitions, and existing runtime mutation boundaries.
The public identity, simulation-time, command, event, activity, and reservation concepts are coherent foundations for both later detailed and abstract executors.
Game-defined components register deterministically without exposing serializer or store internals as public authority.
Persistence classifications and fresh-process round-trip evidence are understandable and complete.
The direct and save/load wood-workflow branches are semantically equivalent and conserve all three units of wood.
Activity and reservation failure diagnostics are sufficient to understand stale revisions, conflicts, invalidation, and rollback without a debugger.
Artifacts clearly separate automated semantic evidence from advisory timing data and future deferred capabilities.
No speculative archetype rewrite, dynamic plugin loader, discrete-event queue, multi-fidelity transition, or M030 asset integration was introduced.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. A waiver is acceptable only if this pending request is explicitly amended before review to authorize one and the completed record states the bounded reason.

decisionHistory.notes: Repository user reviewed and approved M031 architecture, runtime ownership correction, persistence/inspection evidence, diagnostics, and bounded wood-workflow equivalence.
